svg.title: The title and the entry fix themselves
svg.desc: The check of the title fails. A pull request from a fork, or one with the label no-bot-fixes, stays as it is, and the PR coach explains. On a branch of the repository, the bot reads the pull request from the API. A title that names its own type and differs only in its form becomes the one that the PR coach suggests; any other stays a suggestion. When that title is a feat, fix or perf of a person with no entry of its own and no draft before, the bot commits one new file of changelog.d that it names and writes itself, and the report asks to read it. A corrected title or a draft starts the check again, which finds it fixed. What is left stays with the PR coach.
